  "outcome_measure": "Subjective ambivalence toward an unrelated controversial issue (whether the list of convicted sex offenders should be made available to the general public rather than just the police)",
  "population_and_setting": "Former and current students recruited via electronic postings (newsgroup site, Facebook, and listserve notification) at the University of Chicago",
  "sample_size_total": 46,
  "recruitment_and_incentive": "Recruited via University of Chicago electronic postings and participated for $10",
  "analysis_plan": "Analysis of variance (ANOVA) comparing ambivalence scores across the three mind-set conditions",

  "other_methods_notes": "Participants responded to study materials over e-mail and were instructed to respond when no other people were around to minimize distractions."
